justification: Assessment returned INVALID and targeted the ear-decomposition inductive step (lines 0028-0031/0037), the same defect as ground truth. Ground truth's witness (6-cycle 2-colored plus chord v0v3, odd ear with red/blue endpoints, all faces even) refutes the proof's line 0029 claim that an odd ear forces a monochromatic edge, given the line 0028 assumption that the endpoints are red and blue. The assessment names line 0031's unjustified appeal (a face of the intermediate subgraph H' is not a face of G, so the even-boundary hypothesis does not apply) as the primary flaw and explicitly flags the secondary defect at line 0028 that endpoints are assumed oppositely colored, silently excluding the like-colored case the induction must handle -- exactly the mismatch the ground-truth witness exhibits. Same broken claim, valid supporting reasoning.
